body.statement: Satisfiability of a conjunctive normal form in which every clause has at most three literals is NP-complete under polynomial-time many-one reductions.

source.locator: Complexity preliminaries and the standard NP-complete satisfiability source problem; stable publication record at https://www.cs.ox.ac.uk/publications/publication4663-abstract.html
source.verbatim_statement: Let 3SAT = {<F> | <F> is a satisfiable CNF formula where each clause has at most three literal }. Theorem. Both SAT and 3SAT are NP-complete.

upstream.citation: Chris Pollett, NP, NP-Completeness, Reductions, CS255 lecture, San Jose State University, 2019
